task.name: grab_socket_unplug_charger_ep1
task.description: Grab the socket with the right arm and unplug the charger with the left arm.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the socket.
2. Grasp the socket with the right arm.
3. Move the left arm to approach and align with the charger.
4. Grasp the charger with the left arm.
5. Unplug the charger from the socket using the left arm.
